name: Mateo Rodriguez
bio:
Mateo Rodriguez's passion for motorsport ignited at a young age, tinkering with engines in his grandfather's garage in Buenos Aires. He quickly excelled in engineering studies, earning a degree with honors and specializing in aerodynamics. He started his career at a small racing outfit, rapidly proving his abilities in vehicle dynamics and data analysis, leading to a role at Target Racing.

As Technical Director, Mateo brings a relentless focus on optimizing performance through innovation and meticulous planning. He is known for his data-driven approach, constantly seeking marginal gains through advanced simulation and trackside analysis. He has a knack for identifying and nurturing young engineering talent, building a strong, collaborative team around him.

Mateo's visionary leadership style stems from his ability to anticipate future technological trends in motorsport. He is particularly interested in sustainable technologies and believes that these will be crucial for the sport's long-term success. His ambition is to lead Target Racing to multiple championships, driven by cutting-edge engineering and strategic excellence.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight fade on the sides
physical.description: Mateo is of average height with a lean build, often seen with a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with engineering diagrams.
Has a habit of pacing when deep in thought.
Prefers mate over coffee, even during late nights at the track.
